week.label: Monday
week.text: Monday itself is on the quiet side, and the anchor is Kaleo ($49) at Higher Ground Ballroom in South Burlington at 8, with Vincent Lima opening.

week.label: Tuesday
week.text: Tuesday fills up fast. Shelburne Farms hosts a Pasture Walk & Picnic from 3 to 5:30, a guided mile or two through the pastures looking at soil, grazing and what all of it does for the land, closing…

week.label: Wednesday
week.text: Wednesday is the fullest day of the four even with rain in the forecast. Our own Pick-up Basketball [MEETUP] runs 5:30 to 7:30 at Pomeroy Park in the Old North End, outdoors and free like always.

week.label: Thursday
week.text: Thursday is the marquee. Thundercat ($54.50, kids 12 and under free) plays Waterfront Park at 7, and the Grammy winning bassist wraps a crowd up in jazz fusion, funk and soul like nobody else working.

week.label: Thursday
week.text: Thursday also has plenty for people who would rather do something than watch something. The Old East End holds its monthly Potluck in the Park at Schmanska Park from 5:30 to 8, and you genuinely do…
